content: Asmuni n ṣṣdaqi i imqeddasen di Urcalim
Zi jjihet n wesmuni n ṣṣdaqi i imqeddasen, ggem kenniw ɛawed am mammec ḍebbreɣ i-tt-i-dd di tmesmunin n Galaṭiya.
Kuř ass amezwar n ssimana kuř ijjen zzaywem ad iḥuz ca n tesɣart di taddart nnes uca ad tt ixemmeř ɛlaḥsab mammec iwesseɛ, ḥima, xmi dd ɣa awḍeɣ, war ibeddi ɛad řexdenni wesmuni n ṣṣdaqi.
Uca xmi dd ɣa awḍeɣ, ad ssekkeɣ inni i ɣa tfarzem kenniw ak-d tebrat, ḥima ad awyen tacrimet n ṣṣdaqi nwem ɣar Urcalim.
Uca mařa tuɣa icuwwar ad raḥeɣ necc ɛawed dinni, xenni ad kkaren ad raḥen akidi.
Ad ɣarwem dd-aseɣ xmi dd ɣa kkeɣ x Makiduniya. Minzi ad dd-kkeɣ x webrid n Makiduniya,
uca mařa izemmar ad qqimeɣ akidwem niɣ ad sseɛduɣ řmecta akidwem, ḥima xenni kenniw tzemmarem ad ayi tessqebbḍem mani ɣa raḥeɣ.
Minzi war xseɣ ad kenniw ẓareɣ řexxu am dd xawem i ɣa kkeɣ abrid waha, minzi ssitimeɣ ad qqimeɣ akidwem ca n řweqt, mařa ismeḥ Sidi inu.
Maca ad qqimeɣ ɛad di Afasus ař ass n Řɛid n Xemsin n Wussan.
Minzi aqa tennurzem ayi-dd tewwart tameqqrant, maca aqa din ijj n ubarru n řɛedyan.
Taneggarut d useǧem
Mařa yiweḍ-dd Timutiyu ɣarwem, ḥḍam maḥend izemmar ad din yiři jar awem břa tiggʷudi, minzi netta ittegg řxedmet n SIDI am necc.
S uya uřa d ijjen ad t isseḥqar, maca qebbḍem t di řehna, ḥima ad ɣari dd-yas, minzi necc ttrajiɣ t ak-d wawmaten.
Zi jjihet n tawmat Apullus, a awmaten inu, aqa zawgeɣ t aṭṭas, ḥima ad ɣarwem dd-yas ak-d wawmaten, maca netta tuɣa war iɛewweř ad dd-yas řexxu, maca ad dd-yas xmi d as i ɣa isarreḥ řweqt.
Ḥḍam, beddem nican di l’iman, ḥezmem s teryast, iřim tmeḥḍem.
Jjem marra min tᵉtteggem ad yiři s tayri.
Ttzawgeɣ kenniw, a aytma, zi jjihet n twacunt n Stifanus, maɣar tessnem aqa aten d ṣṣabet tamezwarut n Axaya, u nitni ṭewwɛen ixef nsen i tsexxart di ṭṭweɛ n imqeddasen,
aqa ggem ixef nwem sadu ufus n yinni am nitni uca sadu kuř ijjen i ixeddmen akidneɣ u i d aneɣ ittɛawanen.
Aqa farḥeɣ s twasit n Stifanus d Furtunatus d Axayikus, minzi nitni kemmřen min d ayi ittxeṣṣan daywem,
s minzi nitni ssareyyḥen arruḥ inu d wenni nwem. Weqqarem iryazen am yina.
Marra timesmunin n Asiya ttseǧament-i-dd xawem s řehna. Akwila d Priskilla ak-d tmesmunt i iǧan di taddart nsen ttseǧamen-dd xawem s řehna aṭṭas di Siditneɣ.
Ttseǧamen-dd xawem marra awmaten nneɣ s řehna. Ttseǧamem-dd x wayawya s řehna s usudem iqeddsen.
Ijj n sřam i ttariɣ s ufus inu, zi Bulus.
Mařa ḥed war ittexs Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, ad yiři d amenɛuř. Siditneɣ aqa yusa-dd!
Arḍa n Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ ad yiři akidwem.
Tayri inu aqa-tt akidwem marra di Lmasiḥ Yasuɛ. Amin.

footnotes.text: Maran-ata- awařen-a xsen ad inin: ‘A Siditneɣ, as-dd’ niɣ ‘Siditneɣ aqa yusa-dd!’
